purpose: Paired, fair runtime calibration for easy, normal and hard skirmish profiles after core runtime coverage is proven.

acceptance.easy: remains legal, productive and responsive without disabled counters, transport, defense or recovery
acceptance.normal: is the reference fair opponent and does not regress below easy on completion or stall safety
acceptance.hard: creates a measurable profile/timing challenge without resource, stat, visibility or command privileges
acceptance.all: no difficulty profile produces unresolved controllers, infinite duplicate production, orphaned reservations or cross-match actions

execution.cellPolicy: Twenty seed cells cover both declared maps, both factions and all five fixed native opponent openings; each repeats both original spawn sides and all three difficulties. Normal matches are shared across the two comparisons.
execution.holdoutPolicy: Run the five disjoint holdout seeds once after all tuning/calibration rounds; never use them to choose another round.
execution.primaryMetric: Upper-minus-lower authoritative win score (win=1,tie=0.5,loss=0), averaged across both sides within each seed.
execution.confidencePolicy: Distribution-free Hoeffding intervals on independent seed clusters in [-1,1], adjusted for five declared looks and two comparisons to retain family-wise95% coverage; a nonpositive lower bound remains indistinguishable, not a pass.
execution.baselineLimit: Pinned legacy source has no new difficulty/opening policies. Execute its native legacy reference matches separately; report that policy comparison as unsupported, never as a pass or candidate fallback.
